texts.text: Types of Securing and Anti-Loosening Fasteners
In addition to these mechanical solutions, anti-loosening can also be achieved by special adhesives.
Locking Screwsecosyn® fixScrews with integrated spring washers. Reduce parts and speed up assembly times with this multi-purpose fastener.
Screws with integrated spring washers. Reduce parts and speed up assembly times with this multi-purpose fastener.
Combi Hexagon Nuts ecosyn® SEFSelf-locking nut with an integrated conical spring washer and large contact surface. Ideal for electrically conductive contacts.
Self-locking nut with an integrated conical spring washer and large contact surface. Ideal for electrically conductive contacts.
Locknuts with maximum axial runout accuracy. Highest security against loosening for spindle, shaft, and axle applications.
Wedge Lock Washers NORD-LOCK®Maximum security for bolted joints by utilizing tension instead of friction. Resistant to vibrations and dynamic loads.
Maximum security for bolted joints by utilizing tension instead of friction. Resistant to vibrations and dynamic loads.
Ribbed Lock Washers Schnorr®Disc spring and bolt locking systems for applications under strong forces and loads. Safety washers.
Disc spring and bolt locking systems for applications under strong forces and loads. Safety washers.
Unique self-locking technology. Hexagon flange nuts and tools such as taps, inserts, thread gauges, and thread milling cutters.
All-Metal Lock NutsVargal®Prevailing torque hex lock nuts for reliable anti-loosening. High vibration and temperature resistance. Easy assembly.
Prevailing torque hex lock nuts for reliable anti-loosening. High vibration and temperature resistance. Easy assembly.
The products listed here may not be available in all countries. In case of questions, please contact us.
